transcript.reasoning:
We need to verify loss calculation: Commissioning loss 7.5 dB A-ODF to B-ODF. Measured A-TX 1.44 dBm, B-ODF -8.25 dBm. Loss from TX to B-ODF is 1.44 - (-8.25)=9.69 dB. Wait includes patch cord? A-TX measured at transmitter output at site A patch cord. Likely includes A-ODF. So fiber loss increased. Original commissioning loss 7.5 dB A-ODF to B-ODF. Now 9.69 dB? Actually TX output 1.44 dBm, at B-ODF -8.25, difference 9.69 dB. Could be TX changed? TX spec -1 to +2. Previously average Rx was -11.15 dBm with attenuator 5 dB, so B-ODF would be -6.15 dBm. With TX ~1.44 now, fiber loss =1.44 - (-6.15)=7.59 dB, close to commissioning. Now B-ODF is -8.25, so fiber loss ~9.69 dB, increase ~2.1 dB. OTDR shows 2.56 dB reflective loss at MID-PP. That matches.

Connector damage likely causes high reflectance and loss. Fault type damaged_connector. Element_id MID-PP. Action replace_connector.

We should also check if cleaning attempted didn't help. The inspection shows scratch. Good.

args.evidence: Rx power dropped from ~-11.1 dBm to ~-13.4 dBm after patching work at MID-PP on 2026-10-22 15:41. Power measurements show A-TX 1.44 dBm and B-ODF -8.25 dBm, giving ~9.7 dB fibre loss versus 7.5 dB commissioning. OTDR at 1550 nm from A shows a 2.56 dB reflective event at 15.317 km fibre distance, mapped to route km 14.964 at element MID-PP. Embedded OTDR also shows 2.6 dB reflective loss at the same location. Inspection of MID-PP reveals a scratch/damage across the core, while A-ODF and B-ODF appear clean. The high reflectance (~-24 dB) and ~2.5 dB loss are consistent with a damaged connector introduced during the 22 Oct patching.
